newsitem.title: USA: ADP, Business Wire enter alliance.
newsitem.headline: ADP, Business Wire enter alliance.

text.p: Automatic Data Processing Inc and Business Wire said in a joint statement Tuesday the two companies have entered a marketing alliance for ADP's StreetLink investor communication service.

ADP and Business Wire said the alliance provides preferred rights to Business Wire to market StreetLink through its nationwide sales force and through direct links to Business Wire's home page on the internet at http://www.businesswire.com.

StreetLink provides cost-effective distribution of quarterly reports and other communications to both registered and street-name shareholders, the companies said. StreetLink already is used by more than 450 U.S. corporations.
